description: This file defines the Image_Graph_Grid class, which is part of the PEAR Image_Graph package. It implements a grid element for plotting, associated with primary and secondary axes, used in rendering graphs and charts.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Grid
classes.description: A grid displayed on the plot area, associated with primary and secondary axes, used for rendering grid lines in graphs.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Grid
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the grid element.

methods.name: _setPrimaryAxis
methods.description: Sets the primary axis the grid refers to.

methods.name: _setSecondaryAxis
methods.description: Sets the secondary axis for the grid.

methods.name: _getSecondaryAxisPoints
methods.description: Retrieves points on the secondary axis for grid connection, handling radar axes specially.

methods.name: _pointX
methods.description: Calculates the X pixel position for a given data point.

methods.name: _pointY
methods.description: Calculates the Y pixel position for a given data point.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates the coordinates of the grid element based on parent plot area dimensions.
